# League Calibration Requirements Checklist: League-Relative Deck Calibration

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the requirements governing league-relative tiers and the witness corpus
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the canonical league-tier values and the exclusion of A+ both specified for machine-readable output and expert annotation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the distinct roles of league calibration, cube profile, deck witness, and draft witness fully defined? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the minimum corpus-readiness counts defined for every tier and every member cube? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the required contents of a full draft witness and a deck-only witness separately documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Are all mandatory audit fields for a derived evaluation identified, including engine, calibration, provenance, breakdown, and material factors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016; Constitution §III]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “relative to the source snapshot's league” defined precisely enough to prevent using the cube snapshot itself as the comparison population? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “upper placement within A” clearly constrained to explanatory metadata rather than a sixth tier or numeric grade? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004; SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary between league-relative overall tier and cube-specific synergy evidence explicit? [Clarity, Spec §US1 Acceptance Scenario 2; FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is “complete card resolution” defined with the minimum card identity and evaluation fields required offline? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008; SC-001]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the meaning of evaluation-only, calibration-eligible, and training-permitted use unambiguous and mutually consistent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the shared `powered_vintage` comparison rules consistent with the requirement that Arena Powered and Nico retain distinct snapshots and archetype evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002; SC-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the expected A tier and observed 0-3 result consistently treated as independent facts throughout the stories, requirements, and outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §US2 Acceptance Scenario 3; FR-010; SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the provisional-calibration rule consistent with allowing a valid first witness before readiness thresholds are met? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases; FR-014]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the seed-42 role consistently limited to deterministic replay rather than expert deck-quality calibration? [Consistency, Spec §US3 Acceptance Scenario 3; FR-015; SC-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can the 45 ordered picks, 45 distinct drafted cards, 40-card final deck, and offline resolution criteria be objectively measured from the preserved witness? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Can anonymity be objectively assessed from an explicit list of prohibited personal and opponent identifiers? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009; SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Can deterministic repeatability be measured using fixed deck, engine version, cube context, and calibration version inputs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the 500 ms offline validation budget tied to a defined representative corpus and reference workstation? [Measurability, Plan §Technical Context]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a cube changing leagues between snapshots without retroactively changing historical witnesses? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for incomplete drafts, unannotated drafts, and deck-only witnesses without conflating their permitted uses? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; FR-012]
- [ ] CHK021 Are disagreement-preservation requirements sufficiently defined when two expert annotations assign different tiers? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are explicit rejection requirements defined for invalid thresholds, mismatched league membership, unsupported tiers, malformed pick order, and inconsistent card counts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK023 Are compatibility requirements defined for callers that do not supply a league calibration? [Coverage, Spec §US1; Plan §Compatibility]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK024 Are secret-exclusion and source-provenance requirements complete for both generated fixture data and generation tooling? [Security, Spec §FR-009; FR-013; Constitution §Product and Quality Constraints]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the no-network guarantee scoped to fixture loading and evaluation while generation-time data dependencies remain documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-008; Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the immutability and version-change rules clear enough to prevent silently rewriting historical annotations or mixing incompatible evaluations? [Auditability, Spec §FR-013; FR-016; Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the exclusion of evaluation-only witnesses from model tuning specified across all benchmark and calibration selection paths? [Data Leakage, Spec §US3 Acceptance Scenario 2; FR-012]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer findings inline and link to the relevant requirement when requesting changes.
